CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE [d360].[STG_CRM_CATEGORIES_PROD]
( 
	[BANK_ID] [nvarchar](8)  NULL,
	[CATEGORYID] [numeric](38,0)  NULL,
	[CATEGORYTYPE] [nvarchar](30)  NULL,
	[VALUE] [nvarchar](200)  NULL,
	[DESCRIPTION] [nvarchar](200)  NULL,
	[DEL_FLG] [nvarchar](1)  NULL,
	[isActive] [int]  NULL,
	[isLatest] [int]  NULL,
	[BNK_CODE] [nvarchar](20)  NULL,
	[SOURCE_CODE] [nvarchar](20)  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [nvarchar](100)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [nvarchar](100)  NULL
)
WITH (DATA_SOURCE = [testsqlpool_ext], LOCATION = N'dev/decrypted/CRM_CATEGORIES_20240416', FILE_FORMAT = [csv2], REJECT_TYPE = VALUE, REJECT_VALUE = 0 )
GO

select * from [d360].[STG_CRM_CATEGORIES_PROD]



CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW EDS.MV_GENDER
WITH (DISTRIBUTION  = ROUND_ROBIN  )
AS
 
SELECT BANK_ID
,CATEGORYID
,CATEGORYTYPE
,[VALUE]
,DESCRIPTION
,DEL_FLG
,SCD_Start_Date
,SCD_End_Date
,isActive
,isLatest
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,FILE_NAME
FROM BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES
WHERE CATEGORYTYPE = 'GENDER' AND BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
;


CREATE VIEW DROP VIEW EDS.MV_CONSENT

AS
 
SELECT BANK_ID
,CATEGORYID
,CATEGORYTYPE
,[VALUE]
,DESCRIPTION
,DEL_FLG
,SCD_Start_Date
,SCD_End_Date
,isActive
,isLatest
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,FILE_NAME
FROM BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES
WHERE CATEGORYTYPE = 'CONSENT' AND BANK_ID = 'CBC01'


with category_tbl as (
select Row_number() over(order by categorytype) rn, * from (
select DISTINCT CATEGORYTYPE from BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES where CATEGORYTYPE not in ('CONSENT','GENDER')
) a )

while(rn<58)

SELECT BANK_ID
,CATEGORYID
,CATEGORYTYPE
,[VALUE]
,DESCRIPTION
,DEL_FLG
,SCD_Start_Date
,SCD_End_Date
,isActive
,isLatest
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,FILE_NAME
FROM BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES
WHERE CATEGORYTYPE = 'CONSENT' AND BANK_ID = 'CBC01'

-- Loop counter
DECLARE @counter INT = 1,
@sql VARCHAR(8000),
@cattype varchar(50);

WHILE EXISTS (
SELECT *
FROM category_tbl
WHERE rn = @counter
)
BEGIN

select CATEGORYTYPE

SET @counter += 1;

-- break in case infinite loop
IF @counter > 57
BEGIN 
	RAISERROR( 'Too many loops!', 16, 1 ) 
	BREAK 
END;
END



CREATE TABLE #tbl
WITH
( DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN
)
AS
select Row_number() over(order by categorytype) rn, * from (
select DISTINCT CATEGORYTYPE from BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES where CATEGORYTYPE NOT in ('CONSENT','GENDER') AND CATEGORYTYPE IS NOT NULL
) a 
;


DECLARE @nbr_statements INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #tbl)
,       @i INT = 1
;

WHILE   @i <= @nbr_statements
BEGIN
    DECLARE @sql_code NVARCHAR(4000) = (--SELECT sql_code FROM #tbl WHERE rn = @i
	SELECT '
		CREATE VIEW EDS.MV_'+CATEGORYTYPE+'
		AS
		SELECT BANK_ID
		,CATEGORYID
		,CATEGORYTYPE
		,[VALUE]
		,DESCRIPTION
		,DEL_FLG
		,SCD_Start_Date
		,SCD_End_Date
		,isActive
		,isLatest
		,BNK_CODE
		,SOURCE_CODE
		,FILE_NAME
		FROM BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES
		WHERE CATEGORYTYPE = '''+CATEGORYTYPE+''' AND BANK_ID = ''CBC01''' FROM #tbl WHERE rn = @i);
    EXEC    sp_executesql @sql_code;
    SET     @i +=1;
END


DROP TABLE #tbl;
